caveats:
Nigeria and Chad are not fully represented

Edge matching is unofficial.  Certain border locations may not be represented according to the particular COD-AB or the particular government position.
dataset_source: Refer to individual COD-AB datasets (linked below)
methodology_other:
Shape was created after merging different countries' admin3 layers. 
Nigeria and Chad have their layers available only for certain regions.
Layer designed to meet multiple requests from different partners and is only for cartographic use. 

Source COD-AB datasets:

[Burkina Faso - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/burkina-faso-administrative-boundaries)

[Cameroon - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cameroon-administrative-boundaries)

[Chad - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/chad-admin-boundaries-admin-1-and-admin-2)

[Mali - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/administrative-boundaries-cod-mli)

[Mauritania - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mauritania-administrative-boundaries)

[Niger - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/niger-administrative-boundaries)

[Nigeria - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nga-administrative-boundaries)

[Senegal - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/senegal-administrative-boundaries)
name: sahel-subnational-administrative-boundaries
notes:
Administrative level 3 boundaries for selected Sahel countries edge-matched and derived from respective COD-AB datasets.

P-codes match source datasets.
